notes.title: To Aid Understanding Of The Controls !-)
notes.content:
Added to the mouse pointer, beneath the current mode's keyboard-equivalence, the current mode's status, as in OFF, ON, or TO-DO, where relevant. 

And to the lower of the ENLARGE-O-SCOPE ring, the left icon shows selected Miner's current mode, and the right icon, any pending mode (which will mostly be digging or bashing). 

If you think you like, but you're not sure ?-) Deffo, see here, for real ... 
https://www.facebook.com/Manic-Miners-1358386104176061 

"Manic Miners" 
"The only game where you can push your rocks, and toss your ... TNT ?-)" 

maddma productions - "i can't behave, me name's ... dave!"
